name: JUNO Physics and Detector
notes: Classified as `review_article` rather than `technical_design_report`: it is a comprehensive published physics-and-detector overview (in Progress in Particle and Nuclear Physics), and no source fetched this session refers to it by the name 'Technical Design Report'.

summary.plain: A detailed 2021 paper describing JUNO's physics goals and the final design of its detector, including the light sensors, energy resolution and calibration systems.
summary.technical: arXiv:2104.02565, 'JUNO Physics and Detector' (submitted 2021-04-06): comprehensive description of JUNO's physics program and final detector design, including 20,000 20-inch PMTs (28.9% average photon detection efficiency), 25,600 3-inch PMTs, a 35 kt water pool, and an anticipated energy resolution of 3.02%/√E (MeV).
